# TPC-Havoc Q2_v2

```{tags} reference, query-template, tpchavoc
```

> [TPC-Havoc](../../tpc-havoc.md) benchmark · [all TPC-Havoc queries](index.md)

## Representative SQL

Rendered for **DataFusion** with default parameters.

```sql
select
    s_acctbal,
    s_name,
    n_name,
    p_partkey,
    p_mfgr,
    s_address,
    s_phone,
    s_comment
from
    part,
    supplier,
    partsupp,
    nation,
    region
where
    p_partkey = ps_partkey
    and s_suppkey = ps_suppkey
    and p_size = 15
    and p_type like '%BRASS'
    and s_nationkey = n_nationkey
    and n_regionkey = r_regionkey
    and r_name = 'EUROPE'
    and ps_supplycost = (
        select min(ps_supplycost)
        from partsupp, supplier, nation, region
        where p_partkey = ps_partkey
          and s_suppkey = ps_suppkey
          and s_nationkey = n_nationkey
          and n_regionkey = r_regionkey
          and r_name = 'EUROPE'
        group by ps_partkey
        having min(ps_supplycost) > 0
    )
order by
    s_acctbal desc,
    n_name,
    s_name,
    p_partkey
```
